hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) cd "$PWD" && npx eslint --fix "$f" ;; esac
if echo "$CLAUDE_COMMAND" | grep -Eiq "rm -rf|git push --force|git reset --hard|sudo"; then echo 'Blocked: dangerous command detected'; exit 1; fi
cd "$PWD" && (npx eslint . --max-warnings=0 || true) && (npx next build || true)
